parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "orchestrator": "RUNNING",
  "incidentIntake": "COMPLETED",
  "criticalResponse": $json.criticalResponseApproved ? "APPROVED" : "WAITING FOR APPROVAL",
  "droneWorkflow": $json.droneWorkflowStatus || "READY",
  "emergencyAlert": $json.emergencyAlert || "PENDING APPROVAL",
  "allocated": $json.allocated || null,
  "droneMission": $json.droneMission || null,
  "alertPayload": $json.alertPayload || null,
  "logs": [
    {
      "id": "log-master-1",
      "timestamp": new Date().toISOString(),
      "workflow": "Incident Intake",
      "status": "SUCCESS",
      "message": "Incident intake validated and categorized: " + $json.incident.code
    },
    {
      "id": "log-master-2",
      "timestamp": new Date().toISOString(),
      "workflow": "Critical Response",
      "status": $json.criticalResponseApproved ? "SUCCESS" : "PENDING",
      "message": $json.criticalResponseApproved ? "Human approval verified. Dispatch orders queued to mock CAD." : "Human authorization safeguard armed. Awaiting commander sign-off."
    },
    {
      "id": "log-master-3",
      "timestamp": new Date().toISOString(),
      "workflow": "Drone Deployment",
      "status": "SUCCESS",
      "message": "UAV Echo-1 status: " + ($json.droneWorkflowStatus || "READY")
    },
    {
      "id": "log-master-4",
      "timestamp": new Date().toISOString(),
      "workflow": "Emergency Alert",
      "status": $json.emergencyAlert === 'SIMULATED' ? "MOCK" : "PENDING",
      "message": "Emergency broadcast status: " + ($json.emergencyAlert || "PENDING APPROVAL")
    }
  ],
  "disclaimer": "PROTOTYPE DEMONSTRATION: External real emergency services are not connected. Dispatch actions are simulated via mock stubs."
}
